name_zh: 哈贝马斯/德国/公共领域/交往理性/宪法爱国/法兰克福
description_zh: 于尔根·哈贝马斯 (1929-) 法兰克福学派第二代核心，《公共领域的结构转型》奠基媒介理论，交往理性超越工具理性构建批判理论新范式，宪法爱国主义超越民族主义构建后民族国家认同，介入德国统一/欧盟/公共辩论六十年公共知识分子典范。
description_en: Jürgen Habermas (1929-) Frankfurt School second generation core, Structural Transformation of the Public Sphere founded media theory, communicative rationality transcending instrumental reason constructed critical theory new paradigm, constitutional patriotism transcending nationalism constructing post-nation-state identity, intervening German reunification/EU/public debate sixty years public intellectual paradigm.
reason_zh: 哈贝马斯代表批判理论如何从工具理性批判转向交往理性建构，展示了公共领域如何作为民主合法性来源而非舆论操纵场所，其宪法爱国主义为后民族主义时代提供了超越血缘/文化的政治认同方案。
reason_en: Habermas represents how critical theory shifts from instrumental reason critique to communicative rationality construction, demonstrating how public sphere serves as democratic legitimacy source not opinion manipulation venue, his constitutional patriotism providing post-nationalism era political identity solution transcending blood/culture.
steps_zh: 研究哈贝马斯早年法兰克福/阿多诺/海德格尔批判
分析《公共领域的结构转型》资产阶级公共领域兴衰
探讨《交往行为理论》交往理性/理想言谈情境/有效性主张
评估宪法爱国主义/德国统一辩论/欧盟民主赤字/公共介入
总结公共领域/交往理性/宪法爱国/批判理论/对话伦理五重遗产
steps_en: Analyze Structural Transformation of Public Sphere bourgeois public sphere rise-fall
Explore Theory of Communicative Action communicative rationality/ideal speech situation/validity claims
Evaluate constitutional patriotism/German reunification debate/EU democratic deficit/public engagement
Summarize public sphere/communicative rationality/constitutional patriotism/critical theory/dialogue ethics quintuple legacy
expected_zh: 掌握工具理性批判如何转向交往理性建构，理解公共领域作为民主合法性来源的理论与实践张力，评估哈贝马斯六十年公共介入对德国民主/欧盟/全球公共领域的深远影响。
expected_en: Master how instrumental reason critique transforms into communicative rationality construction, grasp public sphere as democratic legitimacy source theoretical-practical tension, evaluate Habermas sixty years public engagement profound impact on German democracy/EU/global public sphere.
case_zh: 1962 公共领域结构转型；1981 交往行为理论；1990 宪法爱国主义；持续公共介入。公共领域/交往理性/宪法爱国范式永存。
case_en: 1962 Public Sphere Transformation; 1981 Communicative Action; 1990 Constitutional Patriotism; ongoing engagement. Public sphere/communicative rationality/constitutional patriotism paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Critical Theory / Communicative Rationality / Deliberative Democracy
cross_cultural_impact: Public sphere; communicative rationality; constitutional patriotism; deliberative democracy
